The Motley Fool is an investment research company founded in 1993 by brothers Tom and David Gardner, with a purpose to make the world smarter, happier, and richer.
We help individual investors make better investing decisions and build wealth for the long term.

Fool.com offers free investing news, analysis, and education for everyone, while our premium services provide members with official Motley Fool stock recommendations, portfolio strategies, insights from experienced Motley Fool investment analysts, and proprietary AI-powered investment research tools and data.
What's the difference between The Motley Fool's free content and premium services?
The Motley Fool's free articles, podcasts, and videos are available to everyone on Fool.com.
They're designed to help you understand the stock market, research potential investments, and become a smarter long-term investor.

Members get official Motley Fool stock recommendations, in-depth investment research, stock rankings, portfolio strategies, and ongoing investing guidance from dedicated teams of Motley Fool investment analysts.
Members also get access to proprietary investing tools that combine analyst expertise with quantitative data and AI.
Depending on the service, members may also get real-money portfolios and more robust financial planning resources from our Certified Financial Planners.
In short, our free content helps you learn, research, and make sense of stock market news.
Our premium services help you decide what to invest in and build a long-term portfolio.
How can The Motley Fool help me become a better investor?

Founded more than 30 years ago, The Motley Fool has worked to level the playing field for individual investors by giving them the research, tools, education, and community to make more informed investing decisions.

Whether you're just getting started or have been investing for years, we can help you learn to evaluate investments, understand the companies you own and the ones on your watchlist, build a diversified portfolio, and stay focused through market ups and downs.
You can start with our free articles, podcasts, investing guides, and YouTube videos.

Premium members get access to official Motley Fool stock recommendations, in-depth investment research, stock rankings, portfolio strategies, proprietary investing tools, and insights from our investment analyst teams.
